svg.title: Visa TAP: browsing request verified at the CDN
svg.desc: Sequence diagram: Visa TAP: browsing request verified at the CDN. 5 participants: AI agent, Checkout Enabler, Site Protection Provider (CDN), Visa key store, and Merchant. 9 steps, 4 crossing a trust boundary, 7 failure branches. Based on visa-tap TAP spec, unversioned (read 2026-10-11) (2025-10-14). Step 1: AI agent to Checkout Enabler: Signed GET through a Checkout Enabler. This step crosses a trust boundary. Step 2: Checkout Enabler to Site Protection Provider (CDN): Pass signatures and query parameters through. This step crosses a trust boundary. If Headers stripped or rewritten: Verification fails or the request looks unsigned. Step 3: Site Protection Provider (CDN) to Site Protection Provider (CDN): Headers present. If Missing: Treat as an unsigned bot. Step 4: Site Protection Provider (CDN) to Visa key store: Fetch key by keyid and cache it. This step crosses a trust boundary. If keyid not in the directory: Block. Step 5: Site Protection Provider (CDN) to Site Protection Provider (CDN): Time window. If Outside the window: Block. Step 6: Site Protection Provider (CDN) to Site Protection Provider (CDN): Nonce not seen recently. If Nonce seen: Block as replay. Step 7: Site Protection Provider (CDN) to Site Protection Provider (CDN): Tag is agent-browser-auth. If Other tag: Block or handle as non-TAP traffic. Step 8: Site Protection Provider (CDN) to Site Protection Provider (CDN): Rebuild signature base and verify Ed25519. If Signature invalid: Block. Step 9: Site Protection Provider (CDN) to Merchant: Forward, marked as a verified agent. This step crosses a trust boundary.
